1. Osteoarthritis Cartilage. 2026 Feb;34(2):279-289. doi: 
10.1016/j.joca.2025.09.015. Epub 2025 Sep 25.

A single intra-articular injection of JTA-004, a combination of human plasma, 
hyaluronic acid, and clonidine, versus placebo in symptomatic knee 
osteoarthritis: A Phase 3 trial.

OBJECTIVES: Intra-articular treatments for osteoarthritis (OA) are limited by 
their efficacy, safety, or duration of response. JTA-004 is a potential novel 
treatment for OA for intra-articular (IA) injection, combining hyaluronic acid 
(HA) and clonidine with human plasma to enhance the effects of HA. The 
objectives of the trial were to evaluate the efficacy and safety of JTA-004 in 
participants with symptomatic knee OA, where the primary objective was 
evaluating the efficacy of JTA-004 in terms of WOMAC pain, compared to placebo.
